header: A FacilityDb for LIVE tests: every `run` is a SAVEPOINT inside ONE outer transaction that is always rolled back, so a test can drive the REAL store code (publish -> modify -> delete, audit rows, locks) against the REAL schema and persist nothing. I wrote it because the first Gemini-built tools were tested only with a fake database (`fn(async () => [])`), which cannot see a wrong table name or `FOR UPDATE` on a LEFT JOIN: both made the announcement edit and delete fail on every call. Advisory transaction locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock) are held until the outer transaction ends: harmless here.
